title: Design Guidelines from NBCP
description: Selected National Building Code of the Philippines requirements covering group dwellings, light and ventilation, sanitation, foundations, posts, floors, roofs, stairs, entrances and exits, electrical and mechanical systems, ceiling heights, room dimensions, air-space requirements, and window openings.

reviewer.title: Section 708 - Minimum Requirements for Group Dwellings

content.text: Group D dwellings include residential buildings such as multiple-family dwellings, hotels, and similar structures. The building must comply with minimum requirements for safety, sanitation, light, ventilation, and access.

items: Provide safe means of entrance and exit.
Provide structurally sound foundations, floors, walls, and roofs.
Provide required electrical and mechanical systems.

content.text: Ceiling heights must comply with the minimum requirements prescribed by the building regulations. Proper ceiling height helps provide adequate air circulation, comfort, and usable space.

items: Ceiling height requirements depend on the type and use of the room.
Rooms intended for human occupancy must provide sufficient vertical clearance.
Ceiling height must be considered when preparing architectural plans.

reviewer.title: Section 806 - Size and Dimension of Rooms

content.text: Rooms must have dimensions appropriate for their intended use. Minimum room dimensions help ensure adequate space, ventilation, lighting, and comfortable occupancy.

items: Room dimensions must satisfy minimum requirements.
The intended use of the room affects its required dimensions.
Architectural plans must indicate the dimensions of rooms clearly.

content.text: Air-space requirements provide adequate open space around buildings and rooms to support natural lighting and ventilation.

items: Air spaces contribute to natural ventilation.
Air spaces help provide access to natural light.
Required open spaces must be considered during site planning.

content.text: Window openings are important for natural lighting and ventilation. Their size and placement must satisfy applicable building requirements.

items: Window openings must comply with minimum requirements.
Window placement should be coordinated with room use and air-space requirements.
